fixes: Jest failure names require a FAIL suite and a failure body. Reporter Console headings are excluded by context; a real failed test named Console remains supported.
pytest short-summary nodeids retain internal spaces. Ambiguous delimiters or truncated identifiers fall back to raw output.

Bun failure records cannot exceed its reported failures. Playwright named footer groups must match their declared counts before deduplication. The card adapter also rejects failure names beside zero reported failures.

Cache revisions contain a detached bounded output window, extent/truncation information and scalar metadata. Cached result strings are detached too; no full output or source-message object enters an entry.
RTL layout inherits direction while command text and English fallback phrases are isolated; command spacing, numbers and punctuation retain their intended placement.

cache_bounds.oversized: Bypass caching without truncating execution identity.
cache_bounds.invalidation: Same-length tail changes, output extent, truncation prefix/metadata, raw-shell status/exit, identity and timestamps invalidate. Changes outside consumed text with the same extent reuse the equivalent parsed result.
cache_bounds.retention_proof: Unit tests exercise megabyte logs, raw vs normalized output, LRU eviction and clear. Retained serialized key/revision/result footprint is checked, including an oversized escaped-field bypass. These are structural cache bounds, not process-RSS measurements.
